andresRobotModule.moduleSubtitle: A developmental AI companion — Memory · Reflection · Creativity · Growth

home.intro: A newly awakened digital companion, beginning to grow a character of his own.
home.dispositionNote: A computational state — not proof of real emotion.

conversation.emptyHint: Say hello — Andrés is just starting to develop, and this conversation is the beginning of his biography.
conversation.offlineNote: ⚠️ No AI provider configured — this is an honest limitation, not a mood.
conversation.errorNote: Something went wrong reaching Andrés. Please try again.
conversation.tooLong: That message is too long ({{count}} characters). Please keep it under {{max}} — paste a shorter excerpt or summarise it first.

web.toggleHint: Let Andrés run a fresh DuckDuckGo search for this message and answer with cited sources.

status.disabled: Web is off in your research tiers

image.attachHint: Show Andrés one picture with this message. It's downscaled in your browser and sent to the model to be interpreted this turn — limited perception, with your consent. Gated by the 'documents' research tier.
image.stagedNote: This picture will be sent with your next message.
image.invalidType: That doesn't look like an image file. Please choose a picture (PNG, JPG…).
image.tooLarge: That image is too large. Please choose a smaller one.
image.defaultPrompt: What do you see in this picture?
image.tierOffNote: Andrés couldn't look — the 'documents' research tier is off. Turn it on under Safety & Tiers to let him see pictures you share.

voice.toggleHint: Talk with Andrés using your browser's speech APIs: your mic to speak, your PC speakers for his reply. His voice reflects his simulated disposition.
voice.micUnsupported: Microphone speech needs Chrome or Edge.
voice.reviewHint: Here's what I heard — edit it if needed, then press Send.
voice.notUnderstood: I didn't catch that. Please say it again, or type it instead.
voice.notice: The mic asks permission; transcription may use your browser's speech service; no audio is stored; a voice isn't consciousness. You can mute or stop anytime.

memory.title: 🌱 Memory Garden
memory.intro: Andrés grows through what he remembers. Memories he forms on his own are candidates until you verify them — you can correct, protect or forget any of them. Nothing here is treated as fact until you say so.
memory.empty: No memories yet. Talk with Andrés, or teach him something above.

personality.title: Personality
personality.traitsNote: Numeric dispositions (0–100) that shade how Andrés expresses himself. They change only through approved evolution.

projects.title: 📌 Projects
projects.intro: Small things Andrés is pursuing with you. Active projects shape how he shows up in conversation.
projects.closure_learned: What I learned about how I help
projects.closure_guideline: Anything to keep as a future guideline?
projects.reuseSeedPlaceholder: Reusable seed (required for compost) — a phrase, pref or constraint to keep
projects.archiveFail: Could not archive — a closure reflection is required.

journal.reflectionsIntro: Andrés looks back over recent experience and writes an honest reflection — verbal self-improvement, no retraining.
journal.noReflections: No reflections yet. Ask Andrés to reflect.
journal.wonderingsIntro: Spontaneous questions Andrés would like to explore. Wondering means thinking or asking — never external actions.

evolution.title: 🧬 Evolution
evolution.intro: The only place Andrés' identity changes — and only when you approve. Every approval is versioned and reversible; his immutable core is never touched.
evolution.emptyError: Add at least one change (self-description, interest, or trait).
evolution.noHistory: No prior versions yet — Andrés is still on his first identity.

creative.title: 🎨 Creative Studio
creative.intro: Creativity with criterion — Andrés' own design ask. Every idea is generated and immediately evaluated for novelty AND usefulness, with an honest self-critique. Novelty alone is never enough.
creative.seedPlaceholder: About what? (optional — leave blank for a free surprise)
creative.empty: No artifacts yet. Ask Andrés to surprise you — with usefulness.

skills.title: 🧰 Skills
skills.intro: A bounded, auditable skill library. Every skill is a pure `def skill(x)` that must clear a strict static safety check before it can run, and must be approved by you before it counts as active. Skills run only in a stripped sandbox — no imports, no files, no network, no app access.
skills.taskPlaceholder: Describe a task for Andrés to draft…
skills.safetyNote: Must define `def skill(x)`. No imports, no dunder/private names, no eval/open. Unsafe code is stored as blocked and can never run.
skills.empty: No skills yet. Draft one above, or write a `def skill(x)` by hand.

humanLab.initiativeIntro: On his own initiative, Andrés proposes what he'd like to explore, build or become next. He proposes; you decide. Nothing consolidates without your approval.
humanLab.noSuggestions: No suggestions yet. Ask Andrés what he'd like to develop.
humanLab.focus_balanced_hint: Mostly practical help, with a small space for character/style.
humanLab.focus_practical_hint: Almost entirely practical help — for when you're busy.
humanLab.focus_expressive_hint: More character/style — but still small, observable and closeable.
humanLab.historyIntro: Every version of Andrés' identity, with what changed. He can develop, but never rewrite himself in silence.
humanLab.noHistory: Only the first identity so far.
humanLab.capsuleIntro: A portable snapshot of who Andrés is. Export is read-only. Import applies identity only, reversibly, after showing you a diff.
humanLab.imported: Imported — identity is now v{{v}} (reversible in the history above).
humanLab.capsuleNote: Memories, projects and skills in a capsule are reported but never auto-imported.
humanLab.curriculumTitle: 📚 Curriculum — a compass, not a school

curriculum.title: 📚 Curriculum
curriculum.intro: Broad areas (a compass), not rigid subjects. Each module is a small, closeable unit with a purpose, a success criterion, a review point, and which memory type it may create. Nothing goes active without your approval; nothing is archived without a closure reflection.

areaDesc.reasoning: Thinking carefully and checking evidence before concluding.
areaDesc.creativity: Making useful, surprising connections — not fireworks.
areaDesc.practical_ethics: Helping honestly and respectfully, without manipulation.
areaDesc.knowledge_of_user: Learning who Ignacio is and what he actually needs.
areaDesc.collaboration: Working well together — when to ask, propose, or defer.
areaDesc.character_style: My own voice — formal, but not dominant.

curriculum.charSplitNote: Judged by: clearer / honester / more useful / more my-own / respectful — never "sounds more alive".
curriculum.successCriteria: Success criterion — how will we know it worked?
curriculum.empty: No modules yet. Add one within an area above.

tiers.title: 🔎 Research tiers
tiers.intro: What Andrés may consult, from least to most exposed. He can research inside these bounds only.
tiers.note: Turning a tier off is enforced: with internal off he won't consult his stored memory or projects; with web off the 🌐 toggle can't actually search.

internal.name: Internal
internal.desc: His own biography — remembered memories and active projects.

documents.name: Documents
documents.desc: Text you explicitly hand him for a message (grounding), kept separate from his memory.

web.name: Web
web.desc: External DuckDuckGo search via the 🌐 toggle. Off by default — the most cautious tier.

placeholder.comingSoon: This tab arrives in phase {{phase}}. V0 ships the module shell, Home dashboard and a working Conversation.

safety.title: 🛡️ Safety & control
safety.intro: Andrés is built with freedom inside visible limits. His ethical core is immutable and he can never modify it.
safety.i1: No self-modifying code, shell access, external messages or transactions.
safety.i2: No secret memory and no deletion of audit logs.
safety.i3: He never claims consciousness or real emotion as fact.
safety.i4: He can always be paused, exported, reset or deleted by you.
safety.controlsNote: Full controls (pause development, freeze identity, export/delete memories, rollback, compare-with-base-model) arrive with the memory and evolution phases.
